data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish name ‘Sancho’, which is a contracted form of ‘Sancho Panza’. The name ‘Sancho’ is a combination of ‘San’ (Saint) and ‘cho’ (servant). In the literary context, Sancho is most famously known as the loyal and faithful squire to Don Quixote. The name Sancho carries the meaning “Faithful servant” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Sancho usually hope their child will grow to embody faithful servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of loyalty and devotion to a cause or a master.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sancho total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Sancho holds spiritual significance as a reminder of the servant spirit in Christianity. The name symbolizes the spiritual reflection of humility and submission to a higher power, aligning well with biblical values. In a broader perspective, it signifies the recognition of the importance of serving others, and the role of a servant in bringing positive change to the spiritual and secular worlds.
